CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 7

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

5. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 44

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

16. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
